Abhi start, future ko tumhari zarurat.
Mehnat hi success ka raasta hai.
"Success ki seedhi top pe kabhi crowd nahi hoti."
Failure nayi shuruat ka mauka hai, zyada samajhdari se.
Har roz ek aisa kaam karo jo tumhe daraye.
Grow karo.
Intezar mat karo, sahi waqt kabhi nahi aata.
Bade sapne dekho. Chhota shuru karo. Abhi karo.
"Chalte raho; tumhe lagta hai usse zyada paas."
"Jo kabhi mistake nahi karta, woh kabhi naya try nahi karta."
Mindset ko apni superpower banao.
